```{python}
#| label: fig-synthesis-lib-eqy-partitions
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "How EQY cuts the FIFO into partitions, shown for the write side, with clock and reset not drawn. Unlike a cone of @fig-synthesis-lib-lec-cones, a partition keeps its register inside, together with the loop through it, so EQY compares gold and gate at the matched signals in every cycle after reset. A matched signal that another partition computes enters as a free input at a cut point (red cross): the solver may set it to any value, but to the same value on both sides. (a) By default, every matched signal gets its own partition. In the partition of `wr_ptr_q`, the RTL reads the flag `full_o`, while the netlist computes the full flag a second time from the pointers and reads `rd_ptr_q`. These two free inputs are not tied together, so the solver can set `full_o` to 0 while the pointers say full, and the partition fails although the designs are equal. (b) `bind full_o` puts `wr_ptr_q` and the storage `mem_q` (not drawn) into the partition of `full_o`. The flag is now computed inside, both sides read the same free input `rd_ptr_q`, and the check passes. The cut at `rd_ptr_q` remains, since `bind empty_o` puts the read pointer into the partition of `empty_o`."
#| fig-alt: "Two diagrams, each with two shaded partitions that face each other, the RTL (gold) in blue on top and the netlist (gate) in green below. (a) Partition wr_ptr_q. In the gold lane, push_i and full_o enter a box push, +1, which drives the D input of the register wr_ptr_q. Its output leaves as wr_ptr_q and loops back into the box. full_o crosses the edge of the partition at a red cross labeled cut. In the gate lane, rd_ptr_q, at a red cross labeled cut, and push_i enter a box full again, push, +1, with the same register and loop. A dashed red line with an equals sign connects the two wr_ptr_q outputs, labeled compare wr_ptr_q in every cycle. Red text between the lanes: full_o and rd_ptr_q are free and not tied together, the solver may set full_o = 0 with a full FIFO. (b) Partition full_o. In both lanes, push_i and rd_ptr_q, at a red cross labeled cut, enter the partition. rd_ptr_q drives a box full, whose output is full_o. In the gold lane, full_o also feeds a box push, +1. In the gate lane, rd_ptr_q also feeds a box full again, push, +1 directly. Each box push drives the register wr_ptr_q, whose output loops back into both boxes. Dashed red lines with an equals sign compare full_o and wr_ptr_q between the lanes. Red text between the lanes: both sides read the same free rd_ptr_q, nothing is cut at full_o."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
from schemdraw.elements import Element
from schemdraw.segments import SegmentPoly
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'     # gold
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'   # gate
RED, GREY = '#b85450', '#666666'

XP = 0.9                                # left edge of a partition, where the cut points sit


class Region(Element):
    ''' A shaded partition from x0 to x1 and y0 to y1, below everything else '''
    def __init__(self, x0, x1, y0, y1, fill, edge, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.segments.append(SegmentPoly([(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)], fill=fill, color=edge, lw=1, zorder=0.5))
        self.params['theta'] = 0


def line(*pts, color='black', ls='-'):
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        flow.Line().at(a).to(b).color(color).linestyle(ls)


def wire(*pts):
    ''' Lines through all points, with an arrow on the last segment '''
    line(*pts[:-1])
    flow.Arrow().at(pts[-2]).to(pts[-1])


def dot(p):
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at(p)


def text(p, s, halign='center', color='black', fontsize=11):
    ''' Text aligned to p in x, with its capitals centered on p in y '''
    # A free Label sits 0.1 to the right of its anchor with its baseline on it, so shift it back.
    elm.Label().theta(0).at((p[0] - 0.1, p[1] - 0.1)).label(s, color=color, halign=halign, fontsize=fontsize)


def cut(p):
    ''' A cut point: a red cross on the wire '''
    x, y = p
    line((x - 0.13, y - 0.13), (x + 0.13, y + 0.13), color=RED)
    line((x - 0.13, y + 0.13), (x + 0.13, y - 0.13), color=RED)


def box(p, w, h, s):
    flow.Box(w=w, h=h).at(p).anchor('center').fill('white').color('black').label(s, color='black', fontsize=10)


def register(x, y, name, yname):
    flow.Box(w=1.0, h=1.0).at((x, y)).anchor('center').fill('white').color('black')
    text((x - 0.4, y), 'D', halign='left', fontsize=9)
    text((x + 0.4, y), 'Q', halign='right', fontsize=9)
    text((x, yname), name, fontsize=10)


def compare(x, y0, y1, s, left):
    ''' Compare mark between gold and gate '''
    ym = (y0 + y1)/2
    line((x, y0), (x, ym + 0.32), color=RED, ls='--')
    line((x, ym - 0.32), (x, y1), color=RED, ls='--')
    flow.Circle(r=0.32).at((x, ym)).anchor('center').fill('white').color(RED).label('=', color=RED)
    lines = s.split('\n')
    for i, t in enumerate(lines):
        dy = 0.2*(len(lines) - 1) - 0.4*i
        text((x - 0.5, ym + dy) if left else (x + 0.5, ym + dy), t, halign='right' if left else 'left', color=RED, fontsize=10)


def lane_a(y0, s, gold):
    ''' (a) The default partition of wr_ptr_q, mirrored by s = -1, so that the lanes face each other '''
    def Y(dy):
        return y0 + s*dy
    fill, edge = (BLUE_L, BLUE) if gold else (GREEN_L, GREEN)
    text((-2.6, Y(1.05)), 'RTL (gold)' if gold else 'netlist (gate)', halign='left')
    Region(XP, 8.2, Y(-1.15), Y(1.3), fill, edge).at((0, 0))
    text((XP + 0.15, Y(1.0)), 'partition wr_ptr_q', halign='left', color=edge, fontsize=10)
    text((-0.2, Y(0.4)), 'push_i', halign='right')
    text((-0.2, Y(-0.4)), 'full_o' if gold else 'rd_ptr_q', halign='right')
    wire((0, Y(0.4)), (2.1, Y(0.4)))
    wire((0, Y(-0.4)), (2.1, Y(-0.4)))
    cut((XP, Y(-0.4)))
    text((XP + 0.25, Y(-0.75)), 'cut', halign='left', color=RED, fontsize=9)
    box((3.3, Y(0)), 2.4, 1.2, 'push, +1' if gold else 'full again,\npush, +1')
    register(6.0, Y(0), 'wr_ptr_q', Y(0.8))
    wire((4.5, Y(0)), (5.5, Y(0)))
    wire((6.5, Y(0)), (9.6, Y(0)))
    text((9.75, Y(0)), 'wr_ptr_q', halign='left')
    # the loop through the register stays inside the partition
    dot((7.0, Y(0)))
    wire((7.0, Y(0)), (7.0, Y(-0.9)), (3.3, Y(-0.9)), (3.3, Y(-0.6)))


def lane_b(y0, s, gold):
    ''' (b) The partition of full_o after bind full_o '''
    def Y(dy):
        return y0 + s*dy
    fill, edge = (BLUE_L, BLUE) if gold else (GREEN_L, GREEN)
    text((-2.6, Y(1.1)), 'RTL (gold)' if gold else 'netlist (gate)', halign='left')
    Region(XP, 9.6, Y(-1.3), Y(1.35), fill, edge).at((0, 0))
    text((XP + 0.15, Y(1.05)), 'partition full_o', halign='left', color=edge, fontsize=10)
    text((-0.2, Y(0.45)), 'push_i', halign='right')
    text((-0.2, Y(-0.45)), 'rd_ptr_q', halign='right')
    wire((0, Y(0.45)), (4.2, Y(0.45)))
    wire((0, Y(-0.45)), (2.0, Y(-0.45)))
    cut((XP, Y(-0.45)))
    text((XP + 0.25, Y(-0.8)), 'cut', halign='left', color=RED, fontsize=9)
    box((2.6, Y(-0.45)), 1.2, 0.5, 'full')
    box((5.2, Y(0.2)), 2.0, 1.0, 'push, +1' if gold else 'full again,\npush, +1')
    if gold:
        # the RTL reads the flag, now inside the partition
        line((3.2, Y(-0.45)), (3.7, Y(-0.45)))
        dot((3.7, Y(-0.45)))
        wire((3.7, Y(-0.45)), (3.7, Y(0.0)), (4.2, Y(0.0)))
    else:
        # the netlist computes full again from the pointers
        line((3.2, Y(-0.45)), (3.7, Y(-0.45)))
        dot((1.4, Y(-0.45)))
        wire((1.4, Y(-0.45)), (1.4, Y(0.0)), (4.2, Y(0.0)))
    text((3.85, Y(-0.72)), 'full_o', halign='left', fontsize=10)
    register(7.4, Y(0.2), 'wr_ptr_q', Y(0.95))
    wire((6.2, Y(0.2)), (6.9, Y(0.2)))
    wire((7.9, Y(0.2)), (11.0, Y(0.2)))
    text((11.15, Y(0.2)), 'wr_ptr_q', halign='left')
    dot((8.4, Y(0.2)))
    line((8.4, Y(0.2)), (8.4, Y(-1.0)), (2.6, Y(-1.0)))
    flow.Arrow().at((2.6, Y(-1.0))).to((2.6, Y(-0.7)))
    dot((5.2, Y(-1.0)))
    flow.Arrow().at((5.2, Y(-1.0))).to((5.2, Y(-0.3)))


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')
    # (a) the default partition of wr_ptr_q fails
    YA = 0.0
    text((-2.6, YA + 3.6), '(a) default partitions: wr_ptr_q fails', halign='left')
    lane_a(YA + 1.9, 1, True)
    lane_a(YA - 1.9, -1, False)
    compare(8.8, YA + 1.9, YA - 1.9, 'compare wr_ptr_q\nin every cycle', False)
    text((4.5, YA + 0.2), 'full_o and rd_ptr_q are free and not tied together:', color=RED, fontsize=10)
    text((4.5, YA - 0.2), 'the solver may set full_o = 0 with a full FIFO', color=RED, fontsize=10)

    # (b) bind full_o keeps the flag together with the logic that reads it
    YB = -8.0
    text((-2.6, YB + 3.6), '(b) with bind full_o: the check passes', halign='left')
    lane_b(YB + 1.9, 1, True)
    lane_b(YB - 1.9, -1, False)
    compare(3.7, YB + 1.9 - 0.45, YB - 1.9 + 0.45, 'compare full_o', True)
    compare(10.2, YB + 1.9 + 0.2, YB - 1.9 - 0.2, 'compare wr_ptr_q\nin every cycle', False)
    text((6.9, YB + 0.2), 'both sides read the same free rd_ptr_q,', color=RED, fontsize=10)
    text((6.9, YB - 0.2), 'nothing is cut at full_o', color=RED, fontsize=10)
```
